snippet.title: Slider Quest - Steam Launch Promo
snippet.description:
Plan your day. Watch it play. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5583170/Slider_Quest/

Slider Quest is an idle RPG for people who would rather not do things.

You have 24 hours in a day and a handful of sliders. Decide how many hours go to sleeping, training, fighting, fishing, chopping wood, and selling loot. Then let go. Your hero does the rest. With commentary. Laziness is a feature.

- Sliders share your 24 hours and rebalance as you drag
- A narrated running log follows every hour of your hero's day
- Level up, collect gear, and train skills like Dreamineering and Fishineering
- Build a hamlet with the Codger
- Recruit a party of barbarians, redshirts, priests, ninjas, pirates, and bards, plus a dog
- An incredible prestige system: start over and come back stronger
- 83 achievements

On Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Website: https://yamagames.com/games/slider-quest/
Press kit: https://yamagames.com/games/slider-quest/press/

Made by Yama Games, LLC. https://yamagames.com
